m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You find a small piece of shell that looks like it came from a crab. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You find a golden pocket watch. It looks strangely familiar. Have you seen this before? </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You find a tiny piece of rubble with a stone carving on it, part of a larger stone building. </ITALICS>
I’m no Sherlock Bones, but by the look of things, this is some incontrovertible evidence! One, two, three!
One: That piece of shell belongs to a Crustacean.

Two: That watch belongs to Barclay O’Brian, one of our expedition. He was so proud of that watch! He mail-ordered it from a dealer on Firecat Alley, in Wizard City. Barclay wouldn’t part with it for anything!
And three: That piece of stone looks like it has the same pattern as the two big stone towers at the center of the Pinnacles.
It looks like the Crustaceans took our members of our expedition and locked them into one of the Pinnacle towers!
I’ll bet that one of the Crustaceans in the area has to have a key. Go and defeat one of them and take it, then make your way into the tower!
Who’s this? An intruder! Let me get my claws around you!
You’re right on time! Or perhaps early. Or late? If only I had my nice gold watch!
What’s that? My watch! Oh, thank you mightily! Rutherford’s upstairs... you go get him and I’ll scoot! See you back at the Promenade!
Look me up when you get back to the Promenade, won’t you?
<ITALICS>The Crustacean drops a big piece of stone. It looks familiar... like it belongs to the portal back in the Celestia Base Camp. </ITALICS>
I heard the sounds of a duel, and wondered if the cavalry was on its way! Huzzah!
I hate to leave my work unfinished, though, but I’d best get going now that the coast is clear!
I’ve taken a roll call, and it came up short! Some of my fellow researchers are still among the missing.
We’ve searched the entirety of the Promenade, and found no trace of them.
As we say in the explorer business, it’s hat and whip time! Could you search the Pinnacles for clues to their whereabouts?
Have you found any clues to the whereabouts of our missing researchers in the Pinnacles?
